data.explanation: This letter confirms a new fiber internet contract; no immediate action is needed. A technician will contact you before the installation date to set up the connection. The contract runs for a minimum term of 12 months from installation, after which it continues indefinitely and can be cancelled at any time with one month's notice. The app will track the earliest cancellation date and notice period for you based on these terms, so you don't need to calculate it yourself.
